text:
Gillette Stadium hyɛɛ ase wɔ 24 March 2000 na ɛbuee wɔ 11 May 2002, Robert Kraft na ɔde ne sika $325 million bɔɔ. HOK Sport, a nneɛ yi yɛ Populous, na ɛkyerɛwee, na Kraft Group na ɛwɔ na ɛhwɛ so ɛfiri bere a ɛbuee.

Beaeɛ no hyɛɛ ase wɔ din foforo ase. Ɛfiri 11 May kɔsi 4 August 2002 na wɔfrɛɛ no CMGI Field, ansa na naming-rights deal de too Gillette Stadium. 2026 World Cup no, ɛbɛyɛ FIFA neutral din Boston Stadium.

Stadium no sii Foxboro Stadium a ɛbɛn no ananmu, a ɛtenaa hɔ 1971 kɔsi 2002. Ɛfiri bere a ɛbuee, Gillette ayɛ New England Patriots a ɔwɔ NFL ne New England Revolution a ɔwɔ MLS fie. Ne bɔɔlbɔbea asesa sɛnea tenants hia: natural grass 2002 kɔsi 2006, ansa na FieldTurf CORE artificial turf 2006, ansa na ɛsan kɔ natural grass ma World Cup. Ne Amerika-bɔɔl nsedaa nso asesa wɔ mfeɛ no mu, 68,756 wɔ mfiase, kɔ 65,878 na ɛkɔ 64,628.

Project $250 million foforo a wɔwiee wɔ 2023 sesaa stadium no skyline, de 22-story lighthouse tower a ɛwɔ 360-degree observation deck, ne curved outdoor video board kɛseɛ.

2026 tournament no, stadium no wɔ match load a ɛso wɔ host venues mu, wɔakyekyere sɛ ɛbɛto games ason: anum wɔ group stage, baako wɔ Round of 32, na quarter-final baako — tournament no mu kan no, wɔ 9 July 2026.
